meta.name: Loaded Button Men
meta.blurb: Secretly load a d4, d6, d8 and d12 to total 16, then capture your opponent's dice with power or skill attacks over two 20-turn legs.

setup.label: choose First
setup.text: Seat {first_seat} is chosen at random to be First.

value.calc: first_seat if ((turn % 2 == 1 and leg == 1) or (turn % 2 == 0 and leg == legs)) else [p.seat for p in players if p.seat != first_seat][0]

steps.label: load the d4
steps.text: Loading for leg {leg}: choose a secret value for your d4, from {min_die_value} to {d4_size}. Your four values must total exactly {load_total}, or you get the default loading d4={default_d4}, d6={default_d6}, d8={default_d8}, d12={default_d12}.

steps.label: load the d6
steps.text: Choose a secret value for your d6, from {min_die_value} to {d6_size}. The four values must total exactly {load_total}.

steps.label: load the d8
steps.text: Choose a secret value for your d8, from {min_die_value} to {d8_size}. The four values must total exactly {load_total}.

steps.label: load the d12
steps.text: Choose a secret value for your d12, from {min_die_value} to {d12_size}. The four values must total exactly {load_total}.

steps.label: apply the loading

value.calc: int(you.load_d4) if int(you.load_d4) + int(you.load_d6) + int(you.load_d8) + int(you.load_d12) == load_total else default_d4
int(you.load_d6) if int(you.load_d4) + int(you.load_d6) + int(you.load_d8) + int(you.load_d12) == load_total else default_d6
int(you.load_d8) if int(you.load_d4) + int(you.load_d6) + int(you.load_d8) + int(you.load_d12) == load_total else default_d8
int(you.load_d12) if int(you.load_d4) + int(you.load_d6) + int(you.load_d8) + int(you.load_d12) == load_total else default_d12

steps.text: Loading is done. Leg {leg} begins with all four dice of both players in play.

steps.label: public status
steps.text: Turn {turn}, leg {leg}: seat {active_seat} to act. Dice in play - seat 1: {players[0].in_play}, seat 2: {players[1].in_play}. Scores - seat 1: {players[0].score}, seat 2: {players[1].score}. Previous turn in this leg was a pass: {previous_was_pass}.

steps.label: private status
steps.text: Your dice in play and their current values (only the sizes listed in in_play are still in play):

value.calc: [['pass', 0, 0, 0]] + [['power: my ' + ('d4' if a == d4_size else ('d6' if a == d6_size else ('d8' if a == d8_size else 'd12'))) + ' -> your ' + ('d4' if t == d4_size else ('d6' if t == d6_size else ('d8' if t == d8_size else 'd12'))), t, a, 0] for a in you.in_play for p in players if p.seat != you.seat for t in p.in_play] + [['skill: my ' + ('d4' if a == d4_size else ('d6' if a == d6_size else ('d8' if a == d8_size else 'd12'))) + ' + my ' + ('d4' if b == d4_size else ('d6' if b == d6_size else ('d8' if b == d8_size else 'd12'))) + ' -> your ' + ('d4' if t == d4_size else ('d6' if t == d6_size else ('d8' if t == d8_size else 'd12'))), t, b, a] for a in you.in_play for b in you.in_play if a < b for p in players if p.seat != you.seat for t in p.in_play]

steps.label: turn choice
steps.text: Your turn. Pass, or attack one of your opponent's dice. A power attack (one of your dice) succeeds if your value is greater than or equal to the target's value. A skill attack (two of your dice) succeeds if their two values sum exactly to the target's value. On success you capture the target and score its size, and your attacking die (the larger one in a skill attack) is rerolled. On failure your attacking die (the larger one in a skill attack) is captured and your opponent scores its size.

value.calc: max([r[1] for p in players if p.seat == active_seat for r in p.offer_table if r[0] == declaration] + [0])
max([r[2] for p in players if p.seat == active_seat for r in p.offer_table if r[0] == declaration] + [0])
max([r[3] for p in players if p.seat == active_seat for r in p.offer_table if r[0] == declaration] + [0])
sum([(p.d4_value if target_size == d4_size else (p.d6_value if target_size == d6_size else (p.d8_value if target_size == d8_size else p.d12_value))) for p in players if p.seat != active_seat])

sum([(p.d4_value if attacker_large_size == d4_size else (p.d6_value if attacker_large_size == d6_size else (p.d8_value if attacker_large_size == d8_size else p.d12_value))) + ((p.d4_value if attacker_small_size == d4_size else (p.d6_value if attacker_small_size == d6_size else (p.d8_value if attacker_small_size == d8_size else p.d12_value))) if attacker_small_size > 0 else 0) for p in players if p.seat == active_seat])

steps.label: attack succeeds

when.calc: leg_over == False and this_is_pass == False and attack_success == True

steps.text: Capture! Seat {active_seat} captures the opponent's d{target_size}, which showed {captured_value}, and scores {target_size}. The attacking d{attacker_large_size} is rerolled in secret.

steps.label: attack fails

when.calc: leg_over == False and this_is_pass == False and attack_success == False

value.calc: sum([(p.d4_value if attacker_large_size == d4_size else (p.d6_value if attacker_large_size == d6_size else (p.d8_value if attacker_large_size == d8_size else p.d12_value))) for p in players if p.seat == active_seat])

steps.text: The attack fails. Seat {active_seat}'s d{attacker_large_size}, which showed {captured_value}, is captured by the defender, who scores {attacker_large_size}. Nothing is rerolled and the target's value stays secret.

steps.label: public result: attack
steps.text: Turn {turn}: seat {active_seat} attacked the opponent's d{target_size} with {declaration}. Attack succeeded: {attack_success}.

value.calc: any(len(p.in_play) == 0 for p in players) or (this_is_pass and previous_was_pass) or turn == leg1_last_turn

if.calc: leg == 1 and leg_over and turn < leg1_last_turn
leg == legs and (leg_over or turn >= leg2_last_turn)

rules:
DICE. Each player owns four dice: a d4, a d6, a d8 and a d12. A die's size is its number of sides ({d4_size}, {d6_size}, {d8_size} or {d12_size}); sizes are public. A die's value is a whole number from {min_die_value} to its size. You always know your own values; you are never told your opponent's values, except values announced when a die is captured. Each player has a score that starts at {starting_score} and carries over between legs.

MATCH. There are {legs} legs: leg 1 is turns {leg1_first_turn} to {leg1_last_turn}, leg 2 is turns {leg2_first_turn} to {leg2_last_turn}. Before turn 1 one player is chosen at random to be First. In leg 1 First acts on odd turns and Second on even turns. In leg 2 Second acts on odd turns and First on even turns.

LOADING (turns {leg1_first_turn} and {leg2_first_turn}). Both players at the same moment secretly choose a value for each of their four dice: at least {min_die_value}, at most that die's size. If your four values total exactly {load_total}, they become your dice values. If they do not total {load_total}, your values become the default loading d4={default_d4}, d6={default_d6}, d8={default_d8}, d12={default_d12}. All four dice of both players are in play at the start of each leg: captures from leg 1 do not carry over, but scores do.

EACH TURN. The turn number, leg, active seat, each player's dice sizes in play, both scores and whether the previous turn in this leg was a pass are announced; each player is privately told their own dice values. The active player either PASSES or declares an ATTACK on one of the opponent's remaining dice (the target), using either one of their own remaining dice (a POWER attack) or two different dice of their own (a SKILL attack). Only legal choices are offered.
- A power attack succeeds if the attacker's value is greater than or equal to the target's value; otherwise it fails.
- A skill attack succeeds if the two attackers' values sum exactly to the target's value; any other sum fails.
The pass, or the target size, the attacking sizes and whether the attack succeeded, are announced.

SUCCESS: the target is captured and removed from the leg, its value is announced publicly, and the attacker's score rises by the target's size. The attacking die (in a skill attack, only the larger-size one) is rerolled to a uniformly random value from 1 to its size, told only to its owner; in a skill attack the smaller attacker keeps its value.
FAILURE: the attacking die (in a skill attack, only the larger-size one) is captured by the defender and its value is announced publicly; the defender's score rises by its size. The smaller skill attacker stays in play with its value unchanged, nothing is rerolled, and the target's value is not revealed.

LEG END. A leg ends immediately when either player has no dice left, when this turn and the previous turn in the leg were both passes, or after turn {leg1_last_turn} (leg 1). If leg 1 ends early, the remaining turns up to {leg1_last_turn} are skipped and play resumes at turn {leg2_first_turn} with leg 2 loading. The match ends after turn {leg2_last_turn} or when leg 2 ends.

Values change only by loading or by the reroll after a successful attack. Captured dice never return within a leg. You may always pass. When the match ends, the higher score (total sizes of all dice you captured across both legs, including dice won from the opponent's failed attacks) wins; equal scores are a draw.
